notes: Rows that are not self-explanatory now end their label with a small '?'. Put the pointer on it and a tooltip the size of its own text appears - wrapped, clamped to the screen, and placed below the mark or above it when there is no room underneath. Twenty-six rows have one, spread across Character, Visuals, World, UI, Settings, Send a Global Message and the owner panel; anything guessable from the name (Noclip, Fullbright, WalkSpeed) is untouched, so a row with an explanation looks like a row that has one. The mark sits where the label ends, measured with TextService, and above the row's own hit area so a toggle's transparent button does not swallow the hover. A.help(name, text) is public and a row that is not on this shelf is a no-op. 72 moves the badge into place on the next frame as well, since a row built into a page that has not been laid out yet is still zero wide when it is decorated.
